items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 29:1
items.html: For there is no longer a coupling by striking in the screen after it has been refined from the phase of Keter. For even in phase one there is not sufficient coarseness there for an actual coupling by striking, but only for the descent of sparks, and all the more so above Keter. (Chapter 4, Inner Light, Item 40)
